title: Fantastic for having fun and learning about Barcelona
text:
The experience was great. You tour part of the city noticing details that you wouldn't notice walking normally.
The support material is fantastic and the monitor Federico explained to us very well how to follow the instructions.
We had a lot of fun and learned a lot!
author: patriciaaW1459PO

title: A fun way to discover modernist buildings away from the crowds
text:
The Street Escape is a great way to view some key modernist buildings away from the massive crowds.  It will make you look up, down and all around, allowing you to discover interesting architectural details you might have otherwise missed.

Some of the tasks were a bit fiddly to handle as there were so many things to hold - a book, a map, 2 wooden boxes, a notebook and pen, etc. so the activity might be best suited for groups of about 3-5 people.  There were only 2 of us (neither of us great puzzle solvers!) so we failed to complete the task. But Federico was so nice about it and still gave us
author: JCorr

title: Great challenge!
text: Great time spent with my granddaughter! A nice walk, a magnificent setting, and a challenge that she was passionate about!
author: annedX6468XA

title: An experience not to be missed
text: A great time spent as a family with adults. A really nice way to discover the neighborhood around Casa Batlló and the architectural wonders it contains. The puzzles are well put together, neither too difficult to get bored, nor too simple to be simplistic. Pure fun! And at the start as well as at the finish, the 2 people we had at Casa Batlló were adorable and motivating! I recommend it 200%!!!
author: D498RLdelphinem

title: Fun and educational
text: A fun and at the same time educational experience. It allows you to discover incredible and beautiful modernist buildings that you would otherwise pass by. Clever but accessible riddles. Very cool to solve them with traditional tools. The GameMaster Federico explains everything clearly but without spoilers.
author: jlacarreta

title: Barcelona differently
text: A great way to discover a Barcelona neighborhood differently.
author: Navigator46857026895

title: We will come back
text:
Federico was an amazing staff member who was full of passion and explained everything with incredible patience and detail, completely immersing us in the story. 

The game itself is very fun, cleverly integrated with the surroundings, and leans toward the easier side, making it perfect for families, friends, or couples to solve puzzles together while discovering Barcelona's streetscapes and culture. 

However, since there aren't a huge number of puzzles, I'd recommend keeping the group size to a maximum of four people.
